deskyard screenshot: PNG of the whole screen

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] screenshot [FILE|-]

Takes a PNG screenshot of the whole screen, after a short settle delay
(DESKYARD_SETTLE seconds, default 0.3) so the screen reflects your last
action. Without FILE, or with -, the PNG goes to stdout. Take one before
acting and after, to see what happened; coordinates in the image are screen
coordinates.

Arguments:
  FILE       path        optional  where to write the PNG on this machine; - or omitted for stdout

Prints: PNG image bytes on stdout, or nothing when FILE is given (the file is
  written on this machine)

Examples:
  deskyard screenshot shot.png
  deskyard screenshot > shot.png

Where: inside a computer it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen computer (-c COMPUTER)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
